Sets the topic to subscribe to. The topic specified can be the literal topic
name, or a regular expression that matches multiple topics.

The identifier for the subscription to update. The sub_id is the sub_id
of the original subscribe command (or the cmd_id if a sub_id was not
provided).

A comma-separated list of options. To replace the filter on a
subscription, include replace in the list of options.

Sets the content filter to be applied to the subscription. Only messages
that match the content filter will be provided to the subscription after
the filter is replaced.
